originality.rationale: Distinct from existing Markovian moment-transfer methods: a complete classification of disconnected mean-square stable learning-rate windows for two strongly convex losses, including the sharp universal curvature-contrast threshold (5+2sqrt(13))/27 and a rational strictly anti-persistent witness. The 2023 two-state Markovian randomized-stepsize results provide a closely related transfer formula, so originality is qualified, not claimed for the matrix itself.
